mentions.name: Tend2Thrive
mentions.description: A compatibility layer for user data autonomy that works across existing tools, including personal CRMs, and correlates calendar events with new connections so users always know where they met someone.
mentions.problem: Users lack autonomy over their personal and professional data.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, I'm building a compatibility layer; something that works with everything - including your own vibe-coded personal CRM.
mentions.author: conrs

mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building https://tend2thrive.com - I could see an interesting collaboration here. Always looking for ways to re-engage your network without it feeling heavy.
